build_culling_bvh.about: the culling hierarchy of clusters given as records (box, replacement sphere, replacement error, level): the node count, every node in the manifest's 15-number layout, then the cluster order (page-codec-wasm culling.rs build_culling_bvh, run by the SDK module, wasm_culling.rs)
build_culling_bvh.inputs: count: u32, then per cluster 12 f64: min, max, parent sphere, parent error (inf for a root), level
